unit.title: More Fractions
unit.blurb: Finding fractions of numbers and amounts, comparing and ordering fractions with the same denominator, and adding and subtracting them.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Find unit and non-unit fractions of numbers and quantities.

O2.t: Compare and order fractions with the same denominator, and unit fractions.

O3.t: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator within one whole.

p: To find **1/4 of 20**, share 20 into 4 equal groups: 20 ÷ 4 = **5**.
To find **3/4 of 20**, find 1/4 (5) and take 3 of them: 5 × 3 = **15**.

For **unit fractions** (top number 1), the bigger the bottom number, the smaller the fraction: 1/10 < 1/4 < 1/2.
Tenths are tiny pieces. Halves are big pieces.

req.prompt: Explain why 1/3 is bigger than 1/6.

rubric.pt: thirds are bigger pieces than sixths
the whole is shared into fewer parts

req.model: For thirds the whole is cut into 3 equal parts; for sixths into 6. Fewer parts means bigger pieces, so 1/3 > 1/6.
req.reason: For thirds the whole is cut into 3 equal parts; for sixths into 6. Fewer parts means bigger pieces, so 1/3 > 1/6.
